import numpy as np, pandas as pd, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
CE="MVLLHHQPLGSHHATTSGGSLLERADLSHPIPENARKLAQLVEYDESRVELGTHSVFVREARPPGAHYSKATVIFLHGQSFSSSTWTENNLLRTFAALGYRAIAIDLPGSGQTRGAAIPQAEKPNFLMDFIETLGLKQVMIVCASMAAQYVLPLMTSTRHLSCVVLVAPSNTHEVVSPSSYTVPTLVVWGERDTSLGPTAAANLKNLPQVKLQKIPDAGHACYLHNPKCFENLCVNFFDLIRSYHH"
HA="MVGALCGCWFRLGGARPLIPLGPTVVQTSMSRSQVALLGLSLLLMLLLYVGLPGPPEQTSCLWGDPNVTVLAGLTPGNSPIFYREVLPLNQAHRVEVVLLHGKAFNSHTWEQLGTLQLLSQRGYRAVALDLPGFGNSAPSKEASTEAGRAALLERALRDLEVQNAVLVSPSLSGHYALPFLMRGHHQLHGFVPIAPTSTQNYTQEQFWAVKTPTLILYGELDHILARESLRQLRHLPNHSVVKLRNAGHACYLHKPQDFHLVLLAFLDHLP"
HB="MAASVEQREGTIQVQGQALFFREALPGSGQARFSVLLLHGIRFSSETWQNLGTLHRLAQAGYRAVAIDLPGLGHSKEAAAPAPIGELAPGSFLAAVVDALELGPPVVISPSLSGMYSLPFLTAPGSQLPGFVPVAPICTDKINAANYASVKTPALIVYGDQDPMGQTSFEHLKQLPNHRVLIMKGAGHPCYLDKPEEWHTGLLDFLQGLQ"
KD=dict(A=1.8,R=-4.5,N=-3.5,D=-3.5,C=2.5,Q=-3.5,E=-3.5,G=-0.4,H=-3.2,I=4.5,L=3.8,K=-3.9,M=1.9,F=2.8,P=-1.6,S=-0.8,T=-0.7,W=-0.9,Y=-1.3,V=4.2)
def kd(seq,w=19):
    v=np.array([KD[c] for c in seq]); return np.convolve(v,np.ones(w)/w,mode='valid')
rows=[]
fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(11,4.2))
for name,s,col in [("C. elegans ABHD-14 (Q9N366)",CE,"#2f6fb5"),("Human ABHD14A (Q9BUJ0)",HA,"#c0504d"),("Human ABHD14B (Q96IU4)",HB,"#4f9153")]:
    y=kd(s,19); x=np.arange(10,10+len(y))
    ax.plot(x,y,color=col,lw=1.6,label=name)
    i=int(np.argmax(y))
    rows.append(dict(protein=name,max_KD19=round(float(y.max()),2),centre_residue=int(x[i]),
                     window_seq=s[max(0,x[i]-10):x[i]+9], n_windows_above_1_6=int((y>1.6).sum())))
ax.axhline(1.6,ls="--",c="grey",lw=1.0); ax.text(5,1.68,"KD = 1.6 (common TM-helix threshold)",fontsize=8,color="grey")
ax.set_xlabel("residue (window centre)"); ax.set_ylabel("Kyte-Doolittle hydropathy, window 19")
ax.set_title("Only human ABHD14A has a hydrophobic stretch reaching the membrane-anchor threshold",fontsize=11)
ax.legend(fontsize=8,frameon=False); ax.set_xlim(0,275)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
print(pd.DataFrame(rows).to_string(index=False))
